documents.text: Bags from PO-009 arrived damp at the school cluster warehouse in Jonglei, and many bags were torn. About 5,432 kg cannot be used. In my view the supplier's packaging was not fit for the season.

The program truck loaded PO-009 at the depot on 2026-05-14, after the handover. Heavy rain closed the road for 3 days and the truck waited uncovered. It reached the school cluster warehouse on 2026-05-18.
